segments.name: Home
products: home equity loans and lines of credit
segments.description: Matches consumers seeking home loans with a nationwide network of lender Network Partners on the online marketplace.
segments.evidence: Our Home segment includes the following products: purchase mortgage, refinance mortgage, and home equity loans and lines of credit.

segments.name: Consumer
segments.description: Offers consumers comparison shopping and access to multiple offers for non-mortgage lending and deposit products.
segments.evidence: Our Consumer segment includes the following products: credit cards, personal loans, small business loans, auto loans, deposit accounts, and other credit products such as debt settlement.

segments.name: Insurance
segments.description: Matches consumers with insurance carriers, earning fees for delivered consumer requests, clicks and calls.
segments.evidence: Our Insurance segment consists of insurance quote products and insurance policies in our agency businesses.

revenueModel.text: LendingTree does not charge consumers; Network Partners pay upfront match fees, click, call, closed loan and card approval fees when consumer requests are delivered.
revenueModel.evidence: We generate revenue from our Network Partners, generally at the time of transmitting a consumer request to them, in the form of a match fee.

changes.text: In 2023 the company ceased offering credit repair products when it shut down its Ovation business.
changes.evidence: We ceased offering credit repair products at the end of the second quarter of 2023 when we shut-down our Ovation business.

changes.text: In 2025 the company exited the insurance agency business.
changes.evidence: We exited the insurance agency business in the second quarter of 2025.
